legal_units.title: Change in constitution of a firm.
legal_units.text: Where at the time of making an assessment under section 270 or 271, it is found that a change has occurred in the constitution of a firm, the assessment shall be made on the firm as constituted at the time of making the assessment.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XVII SPECIAL PROVISIONS RELATING TO CERTAIN PERSONS Chapter XVII, Division A Association of persons, firm, Hindu undivided family, etc. Chapter XVII, Division A, Subdivision 15 Change in constitution, succession and dissolution Section 327 Change in constitution of a firm. Section 327(1): Where at the time of making an assessment under section 270 or 271, it is found that a change has occurred in the constitution of a firm, the assessment shall be made on the firm as constituted at the time of making the assessment.
